items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 October 2026 11:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 24 October 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There's a Storm Warning in operation for tonight, then a severe gale warning for Sunday morning, and a gale warning for the afternoon.


##Synopsis##

Very deep low (Storm Boelo) in Hebrides, slowly moving towards southern Norway.


##Wind##

West-southwest imminently veering west, gale 8 or severe gale 9, occasionally increasing storm 10 in the north of the area overnight. Slowly decreasing 7 or gale 8 Sunday afternoon, then gradually 6 or 7 during the evening.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, becoming moderate or rough late in the period.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 6 or 7, imminently backing southwest 4 or 5, then southeast 5 to 7 during Monday morning, veering south or southwest 6 or 7 during the afternoon, then increasing 7 or gale 8 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate for a time, then rough or very rough later on Monday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain for a while during Monday.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in the rain.
